heading.title: Aggregation of Income and Set Off or Carry Forward of Loss

article.title: Total income.
article.content:
66Total income.

Section 66  ·  Chapter VI  ·  Aggregation of income  ·  page 249 of the Act
In computing the total income of an assessee, there shall be included all income on which no income-tax is payable under Chapter VII.
